senses.gloss: m. (Pers. murdah mortuus, v. Fl. to. Lev. Targ. Dict. I, p. 4181; cmp. מָרְתְּכָא) dead, withered flesh.
units: <cite ref="Mishnah Chullin 9:1">ib. IX, 1</cite>) R. J. says <cite ref="M02558"><he>מרדקא</he></cite> Ar. s. v. <he>אלל</he> (ed. a.

<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 906:18">Yalk. Job 906</cite> <he>מרטקא</he>); R. Lak. says, <he>בשר שפלטתו סכין</he> (v. <cite ref="Q00997"><he>פָּלַט</he></cite>); [<cite ref="Aramaic Targum to Job 13:4">Targ. Job. XIII, 4</cite>, a gloss to <he>אלל</he>, combining both opinions: <he>ומורדקא דפלטיה סכינא</he> ed. Lag. (ed. Wil. <he>מודר׳</he>; Ar. ed. Koh. s. v. <he>אלל</he>: <he>דמ׳</he>].
